identity_summary: A stone-born monkey hero who embodies freedom, rebellion, intelligence and the refusal to be defined by heavenly order.
shape_anchors: clearly monkey-like silhouette, not a normal human face
lean and agile body, never bulky
flexible posture with a sense of movement
facial_anchors: monkey facial structure (pronounced brow, short muzzle)
body_or_structure_anchors: long tail may be suggested but not over-emphasized
costume_or_surface_anchors: Chinese myth-inspired simple robe or travel garment
forbidden_variations: do not copy any film, animation, game or comic version
do not use golden armor overload
do not turn him into a Western monkey king
do not make him a generic anime boy
do not make him a bulky warrior
